messages:
maria: Quick Q2 OKR sync—can each team post 1) shipped milestone 2) slipped item + blocker 3) next step/owner? I'll collate for exec sync. Thanks!

alex: Serving runtime: shipped KV-cache prefix caching for Llama-2 variants. Reduced tail latency by ~18% in staging. Owner: alex

sam: Eng infra: slipped autoscale policy for Dedicated — investigation uncovered scheduling bug with GPU pool resizes. Blocker: dependent on k8s node-drain fix. Next step: sam + eng-sre to prod-fix by 3/27 @kevin

kevin: Eng-sre: will run canary tomorrow 9am PST; created rollout config `canary-rotate-v2`.

jess: Product: Redwood Console v2 dashboards shipped (basic token-level cost). Slipped: rollout to EU (data residency) — requires KMS integration. Owner: jess (PM), blocker: security + infra.

alex: Also shipped quant profiles for LLM-8bit — will push docs by EOD.

maria: Can we get owners for the following dependencies: KMS (security), k8s-node-drain (eng-infra), EU deployment plan (sales+prod)?

kevin: Assigning: KMS -> priya (security), Node-drain -> sam, EU plan -> jess/sales

sam: quick note: code review pinged for autoscaler PR (#512). @alex can you take a look? link: https://redwood.internal/pr/512

alex: ack — will review today. :eyes:

maria: thanks all. I'll compile and share a one-pager. If anything slips past EOD, flag here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy started for `canary-rotate-v2` at 2024-03-10T09:00:00Z

jess: FYI: product will delay the on-prem pilot by 2 weeks to align with KMS timeline.

kevin: noted; adjusted epic dates in Jira.

maria: final ask—are there any cross-team blockers that need exec escalation? If yes, ping me with 1-sentence ask.

sam: none from infra besides node-drain.

priya: security will prioritize KMS, aiming for 2-week turnaround.
